name: send21
description: Crypto pay links and API for people and AI agents. Agents prepare pay links and payment drafts over the send21 MCP server; a person signs in their own wallet. send21 never holds keys or funds.

SEND21_API_KEY.title: send21 API key
SEND21_API_KEY.description: Scoped key from https://send21.io/api-keys (looks like s21_...). Pick only the scopes you need: drafts:read, drafts:write, addressbook:read, addressbook:write, webhooks:manage. No key can move funds.
